MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    
    ans = p if k == 1 else 1
    vis = [False] * p
    
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not vis[i]:
            v = i
            while not vis[v]:
                vis[v] = True
                v = (v * k) % p
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
